blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The second week of the Governor’s Cup U-18 Basketball Tournament 2026 uncovered promising talents in both divisions as the elimination round continued on Saturday, October 10. Khient Patrick Gamao of Compostela, Chresler John Medina of Sibonga, Klient Patongonon of Aloguinsan, and Diorel Cuer of Tabuelan delivered impressive performances to lead their teams to victories in games held at the Danao Civic Center in the north and the Dumanjug Sports Complex in the south. In the northern division, Compostela improved to 2-0 in the North Group C after beating Carmen, 63-51. Gamao’s double-double of 19 points and 14 rebounds, along […]...
